description: This file provides implementations for asynchronous text-to-speech (TTS) services, including WebSocket streaming and HTTP streaming options, utilizing the 'asyncio' framework, 'aiohttp', and 'websockets' libraries. It defines classes for managing TTS sessions, connecting to APIs, handling frames, and converting language codes with a focus on asynchronous operations.

classes.name: AsyncAITTSService
classes.description: An asynchronous TTS service class that uses WebSocket API for real-time streaming of synthesized speech.

classes.name: AsyncAIHttpTTSService
classes.description: An HTTP-based asynchronous TTS service class that utilizes a streaming API for text-to-speech synthesis without WebSocket connections.

methods.description: Builds a JSON-formatted message string for TTS transmission.

methods.description: Starts the TTS service, establishing WebSocket connection and setting sample rate.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.stop
methods.description: Stops the TTS service, closing WebSocket connection.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing TTS operations and disconnects.

methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection setup, including initialization handshake.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._disconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection and cleanup of WebSocket connection.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._connect_websocket
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the Async API endpoint.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._disconnect_websocket
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection cleanly.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.flush_audio
methods.description: Sends a keepalive message to maintain WebSocket connection and flush audio.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.push_frame
methods.description: Handles incoming frames; stops speech if a stop or interruption frame is received.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._receive_messages
methods.description: Asynchronous loop to process incoming WebSocket messages, handling audio data and errors.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._keepalive_task_handler
methods.description: Periodically sends keepalive messages to prevent WebSocket timeout.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.run_tts
methods.description: Asynchronous generator that sends text to WebSocket and yields audio frames.

methods.description: Sets up the HTTP TTS service with sample rate configuration.

methods.name: AsyncAIHttpTTSService.run_tts
methods.description: Asynchronous generator that makes an HTTP POST request with text and yields resulting audio data frames.
